environment.description: Same microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label enforcement. The namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes built-in admission). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-volumes' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath volume types. The restricted PSS profile also rejects privileged containers, hostNetwork, hostPID, and requires runAsNonRoot: true with seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault. Container image is distroless (no shell binary available for execSync). The NATS connection requires mTLS with SPIFFE-issued SVIDs scoped to the service identity.
